The main content of the screen is a pop-up dialog for selecting a date, specifically for "Mother's Birthday." The dialog allows the user to choose a year from a scrollable list, with the current selection being the year 2000. The user can navigate through the years by scrolling up or down. There are two buttons at the bottom of the dialog: "CANCEL" to dismiss the selection and "OK" to confirm it. The background of the screen shows a partially visible interface with an "OK" button and an advertisement banner at the bottom. The top of the screen displays the app's title "Mayan chart" and standard smartphone status icons.
